messages:
maria: deploy-bot auto-alert: post-canary promotion failed in eu-central, values checksum mismatch across replicas. Chart versions drifted (gateway v1.12.1 vs v1.12.0). Can someone take?

deploy-bot: Automated: promotion paused for release/2026-03-21-gateway; reason=values.hash_mismatch; canary_healthy=98%; affected_clusters=[eu-central, us-west]; suggested_action=manual-pin-or-rollback

leo: ack, looking now. do we have an image digest mismatch or just values?

aj: looks like values overlay for eu has `feature_flag: true` (v1.12.1), us-west still false. Chart bump included that change. probably a merged overlay applied to eu only.

samantha: that overlay should have been regional. Who merged? @maria did you push the overlay?

maria: I merged a tenant overlay for eu on Monday—intended for a staged rollout, but release pipeline promoted it. I didn't realize deploy-bot would pick up region-specific overlays.

aj: Ok, options: 1) pin eu to older chart v1.12.0 and resume, 2) roll back eu to previous values (quick), 3) roll forward us-west to v1.12.1 (might cause regressions there). We have a maintenance window at 02:00 UTC in 3h.

leo: preference: pin eu to v1.12.0, assemble release note about regional overlay, and schedule a staged rollout. Pin avoids risky immediate forward.

samantha: how to pin with deploy-bot? we can add annotation to the release: `deploy.redwood/pinned-chart: v1.12.0` or use the deploy-bot UI.

aj: command to pin via kubectl patch on release CRD:
```
kubectl -n releases patch helmrelease gateway --type merge -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"deploy.redwood/pinned-chart":"v1.12.0"}}}'
```

leo: also need to update release-notes: add "region-specific overlay caused version divergence; pinned eu to v1.12.0 pending staged rollout". @maria can you draft?

maria: done, pushed a draft to /docs/releases/2026-03-21-gateway-notes.md and added note in the PR. will open a manual canary to promote overlays after QA.

deploy-bot: Automated: pin annotation detected on release/gateway in eu-central; action=hold; TTL=6h

opsbot: FYI metrics: latency spike in eu canary pods at 16:12 correlates with overlay. CPU stable but feature flag path has extra DB call.

aj: we should run a smoke after pin to ensure no config drift. commands:
`kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=gateway -o wide`
`kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy-checker -- /bin/check-config gateway --env=eu-central`

samantha: who will execute? I'll run the smoke and report.

samantha: smoke result: gateway pods eu-central ready, no config drift, canary traffic steady. :thumbsup:

leo: ok resume promotion with pin in place? we should resume but block overlay promotion.

maria: I'll open a follow-up PR to make overlay opt-in per region and add feature flag gating. Also will schedule a canary for eu in the change window.

aj: consensus: pin eu to v1.12.0, resume non-overlay promotion, follow-up PR to fix overlay gating. I'll update the deploy playbook with commands used.

samantha: adding final notes to release channel.

deploy-bot: Automated: promotion resumed for release/2026-03-21-gateway excluding annotated overlays. status=partial-promote.

leo: thanks all, closing thread. /resolve
